emotion_styles.sadness: quiet composition, restrained motion, reflective atmosphere, soft diffused light

character.description: The same young adult man anime protagonist in every scene: dark chestnut hair swept by the wind, moss-green eyes, with a distinctive, recognizable face and consistent adult proportions. Character identity: a railway signal apprentice taking one last journey before leaving home. Signature costume: a charcoal conductor-style coat with rust-orange lining, wool scarf, and sturdy boots. Defining personal item: a brass pocket watch engraved with a tiny maple leaf. Keep the exact face, hair shape and color, eye color, body proportions, costume silhouette, and signature item unchanged throughout the entire music video.
consistency_rules: This theme has one fixed protagonist: preserve the exact character identity in every scene.
Keep the same face, age impression, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, and body proportions.
Keep the signature costume silhouette, materials, colors, and defining personal item consistent; do not randomly redesign the outfit.
Do not replace the protagonist or introduce another lead character unless the lyrics explicitly require it.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in quiet rural railway platforms, amber forests beside tracks, empty trains at dusk; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with maple red, copper, twilight blue; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by wide establishing shot with layered depth, slow cinematic dolly-in with stable horizon, gentle lateral tracking shot revealing environmental detail; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
